Guthrie Rinker Corporation was one of the biggest infomercial companies in the world. So they decided to copy Kevin Trudeau's mega memory show, exactly.

Same set. A lookalike actor playing Kevin. The same script, word for word. The same lighting, the same camera angles.

It flopped. They called Kevin, baffled: how do you copy something a hundred percent and have it fail?

His answer: you copied everything except the one thing that mattered. The actor was performing belief. Kevin actually believed in what he was selling - and people can feel the difference.

What are you copying from someone successful that you don't actually believe in yet?

#kevintrudeau #marketing #entrepreneurship #businessowner #successmindset #salestips

Kevin Trudeau's mega memory demo got challenged live on a talk show: sure, you can remember names, but could anyone?

So he made a bet. Bring back someone in their sixties who just took the home course, and let them do the same demo.

The next week, a 67-year-old woman walked out and rattled off more than 50 names from memory, cold, in front of the audience. Standing ovation.

When they asked how she did it, she said, "I don't know. I just remembered." Then she grinned: her bridge club was in trouble now.

What's the one skill you've written off as "not for someone my age"?
